_comment: Merged into ~/.claude/settings.json by `herdr-nebula install-hooks`: each group is appended after the user's own hooks for its event and tagged so a rerun updates it in place.

hooks.command: command -v herdr-nebula >/dev/null 2>&1 && herdr-nebula hook prompt claude || true
command -v herdr-nebula >/dev/null 2>&1 && herdr-nebula hook subagent claude start || true
command -v herdr-nebula >/dev/null 2>&1 && herdr-nebula hook subagent claude stop || true
